_comment_exclude: Bun test files (*.test.ts) are deliberately excluded from the Node production build. They import `bun:test` and reference the global `Bun` namespace, neither of which is in the declared runtime types: mcp/package.json carries only @types/node + typescript as devDependencies, and the production bundle runs under Node (never Bun). `bun test` discovers `src/**/*.test.ts` directly without consulting tsconfig include/exclude, so this scoping preserves test coverage while keeping the runtime build closed over its declared types. Without this exclude, a clean checkout where Bun's auto-injected globals are not resolved fails with 'Cannot find module bun:test' / 'Cannot find name Bun' even though `bun test` itself still works.
